author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Connection Reference
description: Declares a connection reference in Other/Customizations.xml (<connectionreferences>), so cloud flows and code apps in the solution can bind to a connector by logical name instead of a concrete connection. The connection itself is environment-specific and is bound after import. Connection references are not registered as RootComponents in Solution.xml.

SolutionRootPath.description: Relative path from the project folder (.csproj) to the folder containing unpacked Dataverse solution files (Other/, Entities/). Use '.' if solution files are directly in the project folder, or a subfolder name like 'Declarations'.

PublisherPrefix.description: Publisher prefix from Other/Solution.xml of the solution that introduces the connection reference (e.g., udpp).

ConnectorName.description: Connector name as returned by 'txc environment connector list' (e.g., shared_commondataserviceforapps for Microsoft Dataverse, shared_teams, shared_office365).

LogicalName.description: Full logical name of the connection reference including the publisher prefix. When empty, it is derived as {PublisherPrefix}_{ConnectorName without underscores} (e.g., udpp_sharedcommondataserviceforapps). Cloud flows reference it in connectionReferences.<key>.connection.connectionReferenceLogicalName.

DisplayName.description: Display name shown in the maker portal. When empty, the logical name is used.

manualInstructions.text: Declaring the connection reference in Customizations.xml

postActions.description: Declaring the connection reference in Customizations.xml
